description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for the regex_replace modifier, which performs regular expression search and replacement within Smarty templates. It includes the main function 'smarty_modifier_regex_replace' and an internal helper function '_smarty_regex_replace_check' for sanitizing search patterns.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_regex_replace
methods.description: Performs a regex-based search and replace on the input string, handling arrays of search patterns as well.

methods.name: _smarty_regex_replace_check
methods.description: Sanitizes the search pattern, removing null-byte injections and disallowed 'eval' modifiers.
